issues.detail: The Greek 'οτι αγαπωμεν τους αδελφους' is a purpose clause (jussive/optative) expressing the reason or result of the transition from death to life ('that we may love our brothers'). The Vietnamese translation 'vì chúng ta yêu anh em' renders it as a causal statement of fact ('because we love our brothers'), which changes the logical relationship between the two clauses.
